:::{#exm-mutual-information-dependence}
#### Mutual information of dependent and independent coins
<!-- no-figure: the example reports a handful of numbers, with nothing to plot -->

For the noisy copy in @exm-mutual-information-noisy-copy,
the [mutual information](#def-mutual-information) is positive, because $Y$ depends on $X$.
For two [independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt) fair coins, every joint [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) is $0.25$.
The chunk computes the mutual information of the second pair.

```{r}
#| code-fold: show
joint_independent <- matrix(data = 0.25, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
product_independent <- outer(
  X = rowSums(joint_independent),
  Y = colSums(joint_independent)
)
ratio_independent <- joint_independent / product_independent
terms_independent <- joint_independent * log2(ratio_independent)
sum(terms_independent)
```

So the mutual information of the independent coins is $0$ bits, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
and that of the dependent pair is $`r round(mutual_information, 3)`$ bits
(@thm-mutual-information-nonnegative).

:::
